shared_elements: incised linear ornament covering the surface
repeated small units arranged in registers/bands
justification: A shows only abstract incised geometry — overlapping chevron/herringbone hatched panels wrapping a vessel — with no figures, animals, symbols or script, whereas B shows a fully figural narrative scene (human figures with raised arms adoring a rayed disc above offering tables) plus dense columns of pictographic signs and framed cartouches. The only correspondence is the generic fact that both surfaces are entirely covered with fine incised linework organized into repeating units, which any two unrelated traditions could produce independently.
